systems.country_label: HRIS of the Congolese National Police
systems.owner: Congolese National Police; implemented by the EU-funded Police Reform Support Program (PARP 3) through Coginta with DCAF and Enabel
systems.tiers: Stated fully operational by 29 May 2025 for career and staffing management of all personnel; the HR departments of the provincial police stations of Tshikapa, Bunia and Mbandaka equipped with IT resources for it

note: The only system is the force's human resources system, class personnel; nothing is stated about how stations record reports or cases.
